title: Neuromorphic Satellite Intelligence: A Formal Framework for Event-Driven Architectures, Spike-Based Algorithms, and Quantitative Energy-Accuracy Trade-offs
abstract: arXiv:2610.12471v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Satellite onboard computing faces an irreducible tension: mission intelligence requirements grow monotonically while power, mass, and radiation budgets remain fixed. This paper advances the state of the art on three fronts. First, we develop a formal mathematical model of spiking neural computation for satellite workloads, deriving closed-form expressions for energy consumption as a function of network sparsity, firing rate, and synaptic fan-out. Second, we propose three original algorithms -- a Spiking Kalman-Complementary Filter (SKCF) for attitude estimation, a Temporal Contrast Anomaly Detector (TCAD) for spacecraft health monitoring, and a Spike-Based Adaptive Modulation and Coding (SAMC) scheme for cognitive satellite links -- each with pseudocode and analytical complexity bounds. translated_title: 神经形态卫星智能：面向事件驱动架构、基于脉冲的算法与定量化能耗-精度权衡的形式化框架
translated_abstract: 卫星星载计算面临一个不可回避的矛盾：任务智能需求持续增长，而功耗、质量和辐射预算却保持固定。本文在三个方面推进了该领域的最新进展。首先，我们建立了面向卫星工作负载的脉冲神经计算的形式化数学模型，推导出能耗关于网络稀疏度、放电率和突触扇出的闭式表达式。其次，我们提出了三种原创算法——用于姿态估计的脉冲卡尔曼-互补滤波器（SKCF）、用于航天器健康监测的时间对比异常检测器（TCAD）、以及用于认知卫星链路的基于脉冲的自适应调制与编码（SAMC）方案——每种算法均附有伪代码和解析复杂度界限。第三，我们引入了一个定量的能耗-精度-延迟（EAL）权衡曲面，并利用从已发表硅基测量数据推导的数值估计对其进行填充。
tldr: 本文建立了卫星脉冲神经计算的形式化数学模型，提出三种原创脉冲算法（用于姿态估计的SKCF、用于健康监测的TCAD、用于认知卫星链路的SAMC），并引入定量的能耗-精度-延迟（EAL）权衡曲面。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a formal mathematical model of spiking neural computation for satellite workloads, proposes three original spike-based algorithms (SKCF for attitude estimation, TCAD for spacecraft health monitoring, and SAMC for cognitive satellite links), and introduces a quantitative Energy-Accuracy-Latency (EAL) trade-off surface.
